title: Concession in Labour News: *jóllehet … mindamellett*, *noha … ugyanakkor*
goal: I can grant one fact and set a problem against it (*jóllehet … mindamellett*, *noha … ugyanakkor*).
I can name labour-market problems in a text (*prekariátus*, *reindusztrializáció*, *technológiai munkanélküliség*).
I can write a sentence that weighs growth against workers' pay.

sections.title: Unit 21: Work, Wages and Workers' Rights
body: This unit is about work and pay: concession in labour news, layoffs written without a doer, results with -va/-ve, scalar adverbs for wages, and the duties employers owe.
The unit ends with a text about Nagy Lajos and his 1934 book Kiskunhalom.
